# Proposed OSS Security KB Page: PyPI `lxml`

---

## Package Overview

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **Ecosystem** | PyPI |
| **Package name** | `lxml` |
| **Latest version** | 6.1.0 |
| **Source repository** | https://github.com/lxml/lxml |
| **Weekly downloads (PyPI)** | ~89.2 million |
| **OSV query** | https://osv.dev/list?ecosystem=PyPI&q=lxml |

**Summary:** `lxml` is a high-performance Python binding for the libxml2 and libxslt C libraries, widely used for XML/HTML parsing, transformation, and sanitisation. Its massive download volume makes every vulnerability high-impact across the Python ecosystem.

---

## Known Vulnerabilities (7 confirmed, chronological by patch)

### 1. CVE-2014-3146 — XSS via Control Characters (Medium)
| Detail | |
|---|---|
| GHSA | GHSA-57qw-cc2g-pv5p |
| Affected | < 3.3.5 |
| Fixed in | **3.3.5** |
| Description | The HTML cleaner did not strip ASCII control characters, enabling cross-site scripting payloads to bypass sanitisation. |
| References | [NVD](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2014-3146), [Changelog](http://lxml.de/3.3/changes-3.3.5.html) |

### 2. CVE-2018-19787 — Improper Neutralization in `lxml.html.clean` (Medium)
| Detail | |
|---|---|
| GHSA | GHSA-xp26-p53h-6h2p |
| Affected | < 4.2.5 |
| Fixed in | **4.2.5** |
| Description | Crafted `link` elements with `javascript:` URLs in the `href` attribute were not sanitised by the Cleaner. |
| Key commit | [6be1d08](https://github.com/lxml/lxml/commit/6be1d081b49c97cfd7b3fbd934a193b668629109) |

### 3. CVE-2020-27783 — XSS in `lxml.html.clean` (Medium)
| Detail | |
|---|---|
| GHSA | GHSA-pgww-xf46-h92r |
| Affected | < 4.6.2 |
| Fixed in | **4.6.2** |
| Description | The Cleaner failed to remove certain SVG/`<noscript>` content, allowing script execution in cleaned output. |
| Key commit | [a105ab8](https://github.com/lxml/lxml/commit/a105ab8dc262ec6735977c25c13f0bdfcdec72a7) |

### 4. CVE-2021-28957 — XSS via `Cleaner` formaction Attribute (Medium)
| Detail | |
|---|---|
| GHSA | GHSA-jq4v-f5q6-mjqq |
| Affected | < 4.6.3 |
| Fixed in | **4.6.3** |
| Description | The `formaction` attribute on form-related elements was not removed by the Cleaner, enabling script-context injection. |
| Key commit | [2d01a1b](https://github.com/lxml/lxml/commit/2d01a1ba8984e0483ce6619b972832377f208a0d) |

### 5. CVE-2021-43818 — SVG/Script Bypass in HTML Cleaner (Medium)
| Detail | |
|---|---|
| GHSA | GHSA-55x5-fj6c-h6m8 |
| Affected | < 4.6.5 |
| Fixed in | **4.6.5** |
| Description | Crafted SVG elements and embedded script content could pass through the Cleaner even when `scripts=True` and `javascript=True`. Multiple commits addressed the issue. |
| Key commits | [12fa966](https://github.com/lxml/lxml/commit/12fa9669007180a7bb87d990c375cf91ca5b664a), [f233023](https://github.com/lxml/lxml/commit/f2330237440df7e8f39c3ad1b1aa8852be3b27c0) |

### 6. CVE-2022-2309 — NULL Pointer Dereference / DoS (Medium)
| Detail | |
|---|---|
| GHSA | GHSA-wrxv-2j5q-m38w |
| Affected | < 4.9.1 |
